<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right">Exhibit 99.1</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 75%">
    <P STYLE="font: 14pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 130.5pt 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>American
    Fusion Inc. (OTC: AMFN) </B></FONT><B>Confirms Reduction in Authorized Common Shares and Provides Financing Update</B></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 25%; font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><IMG SRC="image_001.jpg" ALT="" STYLE="height: 122px; width: 122px"></FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom">
    <TD COLSPAN="2" STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; color: #1504B8"><B>Leader in Scalable Compact Fusion Energy</B></FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom">
    <TD COLSPAN="2" STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Southlake, Texas &ndash; May 4, 2026 &ndash; American Fusion Inc.
(OTC: AMFN) (&ldquo;American Fusion&rdquo; or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), a company focused on fusion energy technologies, today announced
that it has filed an amendment with the Texas Secretary of State to reduce its total authorized common shares from 3,000,000,000 to 1,800,000,000
shares. The Company has also submitted corresponding updates to its transfer agent which will in turn be reflected on OTC Markets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The reduction follows the previously disclosed cancellation of
approximately 1.683 billion shares of common stock, resulting in a materially reduced issued and outstanding share base of approximately
1.316 billion shares. The Company believes the revised authorized share structure of 1.8 billion shares more appropriately aligns with
its current capitalization and anticipated near-term requirements.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The remaining authorized shares are intended to support ongoing
corporate initiatives, including potential strategic M&amp;A opportunities, incentive based equity compensation and potential debt settlements.
By reducing its authorized share capital, the Company believes it is establishing a more disciplined capital structure.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company may consider further reductions to its authorized share
capital and share structure as its capitalization continues to evolve and it transitions toward funding growth through operating earnings.
The Company does not anticipate any additional increases to its share structure prior to its anticipated uplisting to a major U.S. exchange.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Richard Hawkins, CEO of American Fusion, stated, &ldquo;Following
the significant reduction in our outstanding share count, we believe it is appropriate to realign our authorized share structure to reflect
the Company&rsquo;s current capitalization and forward-looking needs. This is part of a broader effort to maintain a disciplined capital
structure while preserving flexibility to support strategic growth initiatives.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Institutional Financing Update</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">American Fusion is also pleased to announce that it has received
approximately $793,000 in aggregate financing year-to-date, funded between January 1, 2026 and May 1, 2026, under a prepaid warrant structure
exercisable at a fixed price of $0.05 per share. The underlying shares are restricted and can only be registered in connection with an
uplisting to a national securities exchange. The amount funded to date represents a portion of a total funding commitment of up to $3,000,000,
with the remaining balance available to the Company in additional tranches, subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying transaction
documents.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The financing was completed in multiple tranches and is characterized
by fixed pricing and prepayment at the time of funding. The Company believes this structure differs from the variable discount rate and
reset-based financing arrangements commonly utilized by issuers in the OTC markets. Notably, the facility does not include finance charges,
interest, or original issue discount (OID) typically associated with comparable financings undertaken by similarly situated companies
trading on OTC Markets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Brent Nelson, Founder and Executive Director of American Fusion,
stated, &ldquo;This financing reflects a deliberate approach to capital formation. By utilizing a fixed price prepaid warrant structure,
the Company has secured committed capital without introducing variable discounted pricing features. As we continue to build the business,
maintaining a disciplined and transparent capital structure remains a priority.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Proceeds from the financing have been, and are expected to continue
to be, used for general corporate and compliance purposes, technology development, go-to-market commercialization, marketing initiatives,
and working capital. There can be no assurance that any portion of the remaining commitment will be funded.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>New Corporate Web Site</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company recently launched its new corporate website, designed
to provide improved transparency, accessibility, and communication with investors and stakeholders as it builds out its platform.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">americanfusionenergy.com</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>New Corporate Overview Presentation</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In connection with these efforts, the Company has also released
an updated investor presentation outlining its Texatron&trade; fusion platform, development roadmap, deployment strategy, and intellectual
property portfolio. The presentation provides a comprehensive overview of the Company&rsquo;s technology and commercial positioning and
is available at:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Other Corporate Updates</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In addition, the Company has engaged a FINRA-registered broker-dealer
and initiated the process of applying for a Rule 15c2-11 quotation. Approval of a Rule 15c2-11 filing would enable a market maker to publish
quotations for the Company&rsquo;s securities, which is a critical step toward achieving broader trading visibility, improved liquidity,
and eligibility for higher tiers of the OTC Markets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company also looks forward to the effectiveness of its Form
10 registration statement, anticipated on or about May 15, 2026. Upon effectiveness, American Fusion will become a fully reporting company
with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and plans to file its first quarterly report on Form 10-Q in a timely manner following
such effectiveness.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">American Fusion remains focused on disciplined capital management
and execution as it advances its fusion energy development program and the Texatron&trade; platform.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company intends to furnish a Current Report on Form 8-K with
the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding the matters described herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>About American Fusion Inc.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">American Fusion Inc. (OTC: AMFN) is an advanced energy platform
company focused on the development and commercialization of next-generation fusion energy technologies. The Company is advancing the Texatron&trade;
aneutronic fusion platform, designed for modular, infrastructure-grade deployment across industrial, commercial, and grid-constrained
applications.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company&rsquo;s development strategy emphasizes system-level
engineering, disciplined intellectual property protection, and scalable architectures intended to support long-term commercial operation,
while maintaining a focus on capital discipline and transparent corporate governance.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">For more information about American Fusion and its Texatron&trade;
platform, please visit: americanfusionenergy.com</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
